data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of $70.644m (approximately 12.7% of opening gross claims outstanding of $556.653m) in 2024. This increase in gross claims provisions is reported in the Technical Provisions movement note and reflects adverse prior-year claims development across the portfolio. Management cites geopolitical uncertainty (notably the Russia/Ukraine conflict), inflationary pressures and adverse claims development as contributing factors, while catastrophe activity in 2024 (Hurricanes Helene & Milton) had only limited impact on the reinsurance structures. No detailed breakdown of the prior-year movement by line of business is provided in the note.
raw_causal_phrases: The Russia/Ukraine Conflict has caused significant disruption to worldwide economies, both directly through the invasion and indirectly through sanctions being imposed on Russia by the UK, EU and US. Booked reserves of $21.2m net of reinsurance and reinstatement premiums has been made.
In arriving at the level of claims provisions a margin is applied over and above the actuarial best estimate so as to minimise the likelihood of any adverse run-off deviation.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding and the 'Change in prior year provisions' gross figure were taken directly from the Balance Sheet and Technical Provisions movement table (Notes) respectively. prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the gross 'Change in prior year provisions' line from the Technical Provisions note. No breakdown of prior-year movements by line of business is provided. The report also quotes a $21.2m reserve in relation to the Russia/Ukraine conflict (net of reinsurance); this is net and was not used as the primary gross prior-year movement figure. Claims development triangle is available (gross), used as cross-check but the movement figure was taken from the explicit movement note. Numbers converted from $'000 to millions by dividing by 1,000.
